summary: The RptMnuStudentPreferencesList module is designed to generate reports of student preferences based on selected programs and cohorts. It utilizes dropdown controls for department, program, and cohort selection and generates a CSV report upon execution.
purpose: To create and display reports detailing student preferences within selected programs and cohorts.
business_rules: cmdRunReport is visible only if a program is selected
validations: ValidationSummary1 is used for form validation
Ensure dropdowns are filled with data using UserSession
calculations: Dropdown.CurrentID is used to get selected ProgramID and CohortID
conditions: Visibility of cmdRunReport depends on program selection
Departments and programs are populated based on UserSession permissions
system_behavior: Page_PreRender updates the UI based on current session data
Data is bound to dropdowns on initial load and UI changes
dependencies: CodeRecord for looking up code descriptions and notes
exceptions: No report generated if no program is selected
UserSession.DB.CloseReader handles closing of data reader object
